metadata.title: कोंडागांव का आदिवासी बाज़ार | Tribal Market of Kondagaon | Tribes of Chhattisgarh
metadata.description:
In this episode, Main Bhi Bharat takes you to the heart of Bastar — the vibrant Adivasi market of Bahigaon village in Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh. Held under the open skies and among the red soil of Bastar, this weekly market is more than a place of trade — it's a living expression of tribal economy, culture, and community life.

From locally grown forest produce and traditional grains to handmade tools, ornaments, and herbal medicines — the market showcases the self-reliant lifestyle of the tribal communities. Women play a central role here — as sellers, buyers, and cultural custodians.

Through candid conversations and on-ground visuals, this episode offers a rare window into how tribal markets sustain local economies and preserve indigenous knowledge in the face of modern pressures.
